title: Jazzin' It Up
lyrics:
[brass and piano]

[Verse]
Jazzin' it up with jazz
Dancin' it up with dance
Goin' it up with go
Chance for romance, take a chance
[horns swell]
Lookin' for someone to like
Someone to like who likes
Someone who likes to dance
Dance to the jazz, jazz it up
[laughter, applause]

[Chorus]
And when the band
Is playing that one-night stand
And everybody's jumpin' around
The whole joint's jumpin' up and down
You hear the brass
The brasses blowin' out that jazz
You see the piano player's got his
Fingers a-flyin' and the keyboard's hot
Jazzin' it up with jazz
[whispered vocals]
